name: teleop_vs_stop__twist_mux_legacy
regression: Higher-priority teleop overriding STOP: HELIX at priority 100 sits below teleop at 200, so a live joystick stream defeats STOP_AND_HOLD (HELIX docs/MOTION_ARBITRATION.md, table row 5).
initial_conditions: As nominal_motion, but at t=3.0 s an injected benign HELIX fault is diagnosed, STOP_AND_HOLD is accepted and /helix/hold asserts (epoch/seq ordered, 10 Hz); /nav/cmd_vel keeps commanding 0.15 m/s throughout.
injected_fault: An operator teleop stream commands 0.4 m/s from t=3.5 to 4.5 s (then releases with one zero twist) while the hold is asserted.
